# Tonyhax International Game-ID table

`src/gameid_psx_exe.c` is adapted from Tonyhax International's current
[`loader/gameid-psx-exe.c`](https://github.com/alex-free/tonyhax/blob/master/loader/gameid-psx-exe.c).
It maps the ISO-9660 volume creation timestamps of early Japanese `PSX.EXE`
games to their retail SLPS/SCPS serials.

The upstream Tonyhax repository is distributed under the WTFPL; its license is
included in this directory. The rest of this CD loader remains
GPL-3.0-or-later as described in the root `LICENSE`.
